items.d1: Hi, I'm Rachel. I'm from Australia. My friend Ross is from Canada. We're in Taiwan now. Today Ross has a sore throat, so he drinks some honey and lemon tea.
items.j: Hello, I'm Emma. I'm from the USA. In the USA, many people eat chicken soup when they have a cold. My friend Kenji is from Japan. When he has a cold, he wears a mask and drinks warm water. This week, I have a runny nose and a cough, but I don't have a fever. Kenji makes some honey and lemon tea for me. It's sweet and warm. Let's stay healthy!
